host.description: Network interface address to bind to for client connections.

port.description: TCP port to listen on for client connections.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

log_file.description: Path to the log file (use '-' to log to stdout).

pid_file.description: Path to store the daemon PID file.

ssl.description: SSL/TLS configuration for encrypted client connections.

ssl.enabled.description: Whether to enable SSL/TLS for incoming client connections.

ssl.cert_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format).

ssl.key_path.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format).

services.description: List of services to monitor for availability.

description.description: Human-readable description (shown in logs and alerts).

type.description: Check method: HTTP GET, TCP port, ICMP ping, or file existence.

url.description: Full HTTP URL to probe (used only when type='http').

host.description: Host or IP address (used for 'tcp' and 'ping' checks).

path.description: File system path to check existence of (used for 'file' checks).

timeout.description: Seconds to wait before declaring the check failed.

max_retries.description: Number of consecutive failures before marking service down.

alerts.description: List of alert destinations (email, webhooks, etc.).

name.description: Unique name for this alert channel.

method.description: HTTP method for webhook calls (used when type='webhook').

notify_on_start.description: Whether to send notifications when a service starts recovering.

notify_on_stop.description: Whether to send notifications when a service goes down.

auto_restart.description: Whether to attempt automatic restart of failed monitored services.
